from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,time,json,runpy,psutil,shutil
R=Path('/workspaces/repository');A=R/'artifacts/lean-failure-profile-2026-10-25'

 if r.returncode==0: shutil.copy2(out/'main.pdf',R/'docs/paper/main.pdf')
 (O/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'cwd':str(R/'docs/paper'),'exit':r.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.time()-start,'utc':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),'scope':'Paper expression changes; no new oracle experiment or profiling mutation.'},indent=2)+'\n')

finally:
 w.stop();(O/'memory-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(w.summary(),indent=2)+'\n')
print('MEMORY',json.dumps(w.summary()))
